skill.name: analyzing-docs
skill.description: Analyzes documentation coverage, quality, and completeness across codebases. Provides scoring frameworks, gap analysis, and report templates for improving technical documentation.
skill.summary: Audit documentation coverage and quality with structured scoring and prioritized recommendations.
skill.author: C0ntr0lledCha0s

security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The shell-related detections are markdown fences or read-only grep examples, and the blocker detections are documentation quality terms with no network reconnaissance intent.

remediation.issue: Markdown fences were mistaken for executable backticks.
remediation.suggestion: Use explicit language tags such as text for formulas and report templates to reduce scanner noise.

remediation.issue: Example grep commands may be interpreted as executable workflow steps.
remediation.suggestion: State that command examples are optional read-only searches and should follow local tool permissions.

content.value_statement: Teams need clear evidence about documentation gaps before they can improve docs. This skill evaluates coverage, quality, and priorities with structured reports.
actual_capabilities: Assesses function, class, file, and project documentation coverage.
Scores documentation completeness, accuracy, clarity, and usefulness.
Identifies missing, outdated, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation.
Provides language-specific search patterns for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Go.
Produces a structured documentation analysis report with prioritized recommendations.
limitations: It does not automatically verify every example against a running application.
Coverage percentages depend on the files and symbols the assistant can inspect.
It cannot replace review by maintainers who know product intent.
Generated recommendations may need adjustment for team documentation standards.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Release Documentation Review
use_cases.description: Audit public APIs, README content, and getting started guides before a release.

use_cases.title: Plan Documentation Backlog Work
use_cases.description: Find missing or weak documentation and convert gaps into prioritized writing tasks.

use_cases.title: Improve Developer Onboarding
use_cases.description: Check whether project docs explain setup, architecture, examples, and troubleshooting clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Documentation Health Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository documentation. Summarize coverage, quality, main gaps, and the top three fixes.

prompt_templates.title: API Coverage Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze public APIs for missing parameter, return value, error, and example documentation. Group findings by priority.

prompt_templates.title: Quality Score Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Score documentation completeness, accuracy, clarity, and usefulness from 0 to 10. Explain evidence and recommend improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-Language Documentation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit documentation across all detected languages. Compare coverage by category and create a staged remediation plan.

output_examples.input: Audit a TypeScript library before publishing version 2.0.
output_examples.output: A report with coverage by exported API, quality scores, missing examples, outdated README sections, and priority fixes.

output_examples.input: Check whether onboarding documentation supports new backend engineers.
output_examples.output: A gap analysis covering setup steps, architecture context, troubleshooting coverage, and unclear operational procedures.

output_examples.input: Review Python package docs for public functions and classes.
output_examples.output: A prioritized list of undocumented symbols, weak parameter descriptions, missing return details, and recommended documentation tasks.

best_practices: Provide repository scope, target audience, and documentation standards before the audit.
Ask for evidence by file and section when turning findings into tasks.
Review generated priorities with maintainers before large documentation changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat coverage percentages as exact when generated from partial repository access.
Do not publish generated recommendations without checking product and API intent.
Do not focus only on README files when API and architecture docs are also required.

faq.question: What does this skill evaluate?
faq.answer: It evaluates documentation coverage, quality, completeness, accuracy, clarity, usefulness, and common documentation gaps.

faq.question: Can it calculate exact documentation coverage?
faq.answer: It can estimate coverage from inspected files, but exact results depend on repository access and symbol discovery.

faq.question: Which languages does it mention?
faq.answer: The skill includes search guidance for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Go documentation patterns.

faq.question: Does it write missing documentation?
faq.answer: It focuses on analysis and recommendations. Pair it with a writing skill or direct editing workflow to create docs.

faq.question: Is it useful for README reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks README completeness along with API, architecture, getting started, and troubleshooting documentation.

faq.question: Can it find outdated examples?
faq.answer: It can flag examples that appear inconsistent with inspected code, but maintainers should verify behavior before publishing updates.
